answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue from established customers without measurable retention harm. Memory 44 and memory 86 provide strong indirect support through pipeline quality, adoption, and time-to-value, though they omit direct long-term revenue evidence. Memories 31 and 73 are moderately relevant: activation and revenue lift are useful, but they lack evidence on durability or retention; promotional pricing may also weaken long-term economics. Memory 91 is least supported because it only reports week-one engagement and first meaningful action, with no direct evidence of qualified revenue, retention, or sustained impact.
